forum.title: eFuse STEF05D value of R-Lim
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @jqivol, to the community!

The relevant data sheet is always the [latest official one](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stef05d.pdf), which currently specifies the formula with 42. The document DM00034383 is no longer an official document (if it ever was) and cannot be found on the [product website](https://www.st.com/en/power-management/stef05d.html#documentation).

Hope that answers your question?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
I'm using eFuse STEF05D, found 2 version of the datasheet below which show the different formulas:

STEF05\_en.DM00034383,pdf: **R-Limit = 65/Ishort**

STEF05D.pdf: **R-Limit = 42/Ishort**

Can someone help clarify which formula is correct?
forum.author: jqivol
